Confirmed after reading Definitions 4.1/4.8/6.11 and Lemma 5.2, including their rendered formulas. For a sufficiently small neat L′ with −1 absent, L={±1}L′ gives the same coarse Shimura variety, twice the volume, and half the orbit-sum theta cycle for an L-invariant test function. Thus the volume-normalized quadratic height differs by a factor two, and the claimed arbitrary-level pullback compatibility and fine representability are unavailable. E19's affects-nothing verdict is inadequate. Restrict the cycle colimit, model and height statements and their projection/degree arguments to a cofinal neat tower. DL24 Remark 4.51 itself states neat-level compatibility. This does not refute the theorem with the corrected neat-level convention.

Confirmed. In Lemma 8.2, p may have another inert place in S; the characteristic function of its almost self-dual lattice is not invariant under the Weyl element in K_r, since Fourier transform has support on the dual lattice. At a split place of R\R′ above p the test function is arbitrary and is also discarded by the displayed definition of the new function. The reduction therefore lacks the invariance it uses. Preserve all affected Weil-transformed local components; the almost self-dual case additionally needs a proved replacement reduction or an appropriately restricted theorem. Merely inserting an assertion of invariance, or fixing only the split-place omission, does not close the gap.

Confirmed as a proof gap, with the proposed repair still conditional. Final pp.48/51 replace the full KM theta/Eisenstein derivative by a sum over totally positive T1. Proposition 3.10 allows Diff={u} at an archimedean place with an indefinite block T1; Remark 3.12 addresses totally positive full matrices only. Liu11 Theorems 4.17/4.20 cover nonsingular indefinite matrices and empty-cycle Green functions, so these terms cannot simply be omitted before averaging over a non-product fundamental domain. Regularity of a paired 2r-tuple does not imply regularity of its r-subtuple. For globally degenerate Gram matrices the other definite real place and joint regular support supply a different vanishing argument. Record the missing negative-index/Green-form comparison; extending the summation in (10.1) requires proving that extension and its convergence, not treating the new formula as an established correction.

Lemma 7.3 also needs its conjugate-ideal version and the intermediate localized generic-fibre vanishing over K, not just the existential statement of Proposition 6.9(2).
